design_quote: A risk-of-bias assessment was made for all randomized clinical trials included, using the Cochrane collaboration’s tool as well as a quality assessment for all non-randomized studies utilizing the Newcastle–Ottawa scale.
k_quote: Out of the 25 trials assessed, 16 were randomized controlled clinical trials.
reason: Randomised and non-randomised trials pooled together with no RCT-only synthesis reported.
